1479-2841-5235-8337.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Brokers Hideout.
1479-2841-5235-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Brokers Hideout.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

587-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
587-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sawtooth Loon by paying its mana cost.
When Sawtooth Loon enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand,  draw four cards, and put four cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5268-6244--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-6244--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4247-6566--5--195.easyPrerequisites: At least one persist creature has any type of counter on it.
4247-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4476-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4476-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-4476-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

413-2301-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

475-1379-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-4186-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1902-2079.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-2079.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

338-560-2034-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-560-2034-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5663-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003--73.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist or undying creature dies, its persist or undying ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist or undying creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1818-2173-2921-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-2921-5010.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1669-2438-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-2438-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
1669-2438-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3011-4522-6899.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
3011-4522-6899.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
3011-4522-6899.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to With Great Power....
3011-4522-6899.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

628-3108-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.
628-3108-6797.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

1894-2173-5220-6094.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1850-4693-6850.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4693-6850.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1127-3043-3152.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
1127-3043-3152.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

560-678-4050-4151.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
560-678-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the Soldier and Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5777-6753.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
4231-4321-5777-6753.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

2292-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-4659-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4659-5402-5929.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

2919-4506-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-4506-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2511-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2511-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1109-1636-2263.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Mindcrusher does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-1109-1636-2263.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, causing target player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Repeat.

877-2273-2440-4254.manaNeeded: {3}, plus an additional {1} available if you do not control another Sliver
877-2273-2440-4254.description:
Activate Sliver Overlord by paying {3}, searching your library for any Sliver creature card and putting it into your hand.
Cast the Sliver by paying {0} due to Morophon and Jodah.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

546-1034-4331.notablePrerequisites: Ramos has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
546-1034-4331.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Ramos to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Lux Artillery triggers, causing Ramos to gain sunburst and enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1651-3129-3272-4231.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Mine Tunnels room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, and create two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Dark Pool room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Temple of Dumathoin room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to draw a card and complete Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

224-433-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
224-433-2232.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

31-1068-2034-2835.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature, adding {C}{C}.
Fecundity triggers, causing you to return any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the planeswalker.

1429-3388-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding one mana of any color.
Moritte of the Frost dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield as a copy of Lesser Masticore with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Lesser Masticore's ability any number of times to deal infinite damage to any creature(s).

3099-3301-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Tezzeret has at least two loyalty counters.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
3099-3301-4131.description:
Activate Tezzeret's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing Basalt Monolith to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1995.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Selvala.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power five or greater.
527-1995.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it and paying {G}, adding {W}{G} and three mana of any color.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.
